title: Architecture-Grounded Context Understanding
objective: Integrate the authoritative TypeScript repository architectural map into the existing River Development Agent production context-understanding path so loaded development context is grounded in resolved repository-local architecture instead of independently inferred TypeScript relationships.
architecturalContext: UNDERSTAND-001 is the authoritative deterministic TypeScript repository architectural map and already resolves repository-local imports, exports, direct dependencies, direct dependents, and bounded entry-point signals.

createRiverDevDevelopmentContext is the existing production context boundary. It already performs repository discovery, selects relevant entries, loads context artifacts, invokes analyzeContextArtifacts, and returns RiverDevDevelopmentContext.
RiverDevDevelopmentContext already exposes a RiverDevContextUnderstanding field. UNDERSTAND-002 must strengthen that existing understanding contract rather than create a parallel context system.

The current context-understanding implementation independently detects TypeScript imports with regular expressions and scores relevance using path-name and relationship-count heuristics. Those architectural guesses must no longer compete with the authoritative architecture map.
Planning behavior is outside UNDERSTAND-002. This capability supplies stronger factual context; PLAN capability work will consume it later.
acceptanceCriteria: createRiverDevDevelopmentContext constructs the authoritative repository architecture map from the exact repository discovery report already validated against the current repository snapshot.
The production context-understanding call receives the authoritative architecture map together with the existing loaded artifact bundle.

TypeScript architectural relationships exposed by RiverDevContextUnderstanding are grounded in resolved UNDERSTAND-001 repository-local relationships rather than independently reconstructed with regular-expression import parsing.
For loaded TypeScript artifacts represented in the architecture map, context relationships use normalized resolved repository-relative module paths and preserve deterministic ordering.

Repository-local dependencies and dependents relevant to loaded artifacts can contribute deterministic architectural relevance reasons without inventing relationships that are absent from the authoritative architecture map.
Non-TypeScript artifact metadata remains supported and deterministic; UNDERSTAND-002 does not require the architecture map to fabricate module relationships for unsupported artifact types.

The existing RiverDevDevelopmentContext production boundary remains authoritative; no parallel context engine, repository discovery implementation, architecture parser, or planning path is introduced.
UNDERSTAND-001 remains authoritative for TypeScript parsing and module resolution; context-understanding does not duplicate TypeScript compiler parsing or local module resolution.
Repository discovery identity, branch, commit, protected-path behavior, artifact loading boundaries, approved scope, session behavior, and existing context safety invariants remain unchanged.
The resulting context-understanding output is deterministic for equivalent discovery, architecture, and artifact inputs.
Existing callers of createRiverDevDevelopmentContext continue to receive RiverDevDevelopmentContext through the existing production API.

Direct unit tests prove architecture-grounded relationships and relevance, absence of regex-only fabricated TypeScript relationships, deterministic output, and preservation of non-TypeScript artifact metadata.
Context-engine integration tests prove the production context path actually constructs and consumes UNDERSTAND-001 architecture rather than leaving the architectural map test-only.
TypeScript compilation and the complete River Development Agent regression suite pass.
requiredQualityGates: Focused UNDERSTAND-001 and UNDERSTAND-002 tests pass.
Complete River Development Agent regression suite passes.
No production planning, execution, authorization, commit, push, website, or unrelated repository behavior is modified.
approvedCommands: Node test runner through existing repository tooling
git add for the exact UNDERSTAND-002 specification or later approved implementation scope
git commit for separately validated UNDERSTAND-002 specification and implementation commits
approvalBoundaries: Do not expand into PLAN capability work.
Do not create a second repository discovery or architecture engine.
Do not introduce network, model-provider, package-installation, secret-access, or repository-execution behavior.
Stop if the authoritative UNDERSTAND-001 architecture contract proves insufficient rather than silently reconstructing architecture elsewhere.
commitMessage: UNDERSTAND-002: Ground development context in repository architecture
